young.what: Your skin is the soft, stretchy covering all over your body.
young.does: It keeps germs out, lets you feel touch, and helps keep you warm or cool.
young.funFact: Your skin is your body's biggest organ!

junior.what: The skin is the largest organ of the body. It has an outer epidermis, a dermis beneath it and a fatty layer underneath.
junior.does: It protects against germs and sunlight, senses touch, heat and pain, and controls body temperature by sweating.
junior.funFact: You shed tiny flakes of old skin all the time. A whole new outer layer grows about once a month.
junior.details: Skin gets its colour from a pigment called melanin. Everyone has melanin, just in different amounts.
